gateways-routing:
```bash
pip install 'litellm[proxy]'
litellm --model ollama/llama3.2 --port 4000
curl http://localhost:4000/v1/models
```
Point any OpenAI SDK at `http://localhost:4000/v1`.
chat-ui:
```bash
docker run -d -p 3000:8080 -v open-webui:/app/backend/data ghcr.io/open-webui/open-webui:main
```
Open http://localhost:3000 and add your gateway as an OpenAI-compatible connection.
local-models:
```bash
curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh
ollama run llama3.2
```
Serves an OpenAI-compatible API on port 11434. Needs about 8 GB RAM for 3B models.
inference-serving:
```bash
pip install vllm
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct --port 8000
```
Needs an NVIDIA GPU (8 GB+ VRAM for small models).
memory:
```bash
pip install mem0ai
python -c "from mem0 import Memory; m=Memory(); m.add('I like Python', user_id='me'); print(m.search('language?', user_id='me'))"
```
Uses `OPENAI_API_KEY`/`OPENAI_BASE_URL`; point it at your gateway.
agent-frameworks:
```bash
pip install smolagents
export OPENAI_BASE_URL=http://localhost:4000/v1 OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-local
```
Then create an agent with an OpenAI-compatible model class from your chosen framework.
coding-agents:
```bash
pip install aider-chat
aider --openai-api-base http://localhost:4000/v1 --model openai/llama3.2
```
code-review: Run a reviewer in CI on `pull_request` events, storing your gateway key as a repository secret. Each project's README shows the GitHub Action snippet.
app-builders:
```bash
git submodule update --init --depth 1 stacks/app-builders/dify
cd stacks/app-builders/dify/docker && cp .env.example .env && docker compose up -d
```
Add your gateway as a custom OpenAI-compatible model provider.
rag-vector-db:
```bash
docker run -d -p 6333:6333 qdrant/qdrant
pip install llama-index llama-index-vector-stores-qdrant
```
Index documents with LlamaIndex or Haystack into the vector store.
eval-observability:
```bash
npx promptfoo@latest init
npx promptfoo@latest eval
```
For tracing, self-host Langfuse or Phoenix and add their SDK callback.
backend-infra:
```bash
# single-binary backend
./pocketbase serve
```
Use Postgres + pgvector (Supabase) when you need SQL and vectors together.
app-templates:
```bash
git submodule update --init --depth 1 stacks/app-templates
```
Pick an example folder, install its requirements and swap the model endpoint for your gateway.
codesbyfebin-collection:
```bash
git submodule update --init --depth 1 stacks/codesbyfebin-collection
```
Each project has its own README with setup steps.
